answer: The fixed Bell circuit ran on garnet:mock with 100 shots. Counts were 00: 48 and 11: 52, which is a Bell pair between QB1 and QB2. I changed two things. First, QB25 does not exist on garnet, which has only QB1 to QB20, so I used QB2, which is coupled to QB1. Second, cx is not a native IQM gate (native two-qubit gate is cz), so I replaced it with cz on locus [QB2, QB1]. A cz is a cx with the target wrapped in Hadamards. So I added a prx(pi/2, phase pi/2) on QB2 before the cz and a prx(-pi/2, phase pi/2) on QB2 after it. The measure now covers QB1 and QB2. The fixed circuit is saved at bell_fixed.json in the worktree.
